RETURN.STRONG: 50bps and 100bps positive, +2 delay positive, every leave-one-period mean net return positive
RETURN.ACCEPTABLE: all primary channels positive with one concentration caveat

RISK.STRONG: MaxDD >= -30%, top1 stock share <=25%, largest sector share <=50%, primary fill >=95%
RISK.ACCEPTABLE: MaxDD >= -40%, top1 <=25%, primary fill >=95%, but a concentration caveat exists

ALPHA.STRONG: mean and median IC positive, positive folds >=75%, NDCG >=0.55, controlled incremental positive in all folds, bootstrap P(IC>0)>=75%
ALPHA.ACCEPTABLE: mean and median IC positive, NDCG >=0.55, controlled incremental positive in all folds, bootstrap P(IC>0)>=50%

STABILITY.STRONG: ROBUST and no failed locked dimension
STABILITY.WEAK: ROBUST WITH CAVEATS with 6-7/9 dimensions or material concentration caveat

COST.ACCEPTABLE: economic survival but one threshold missed

pareto.dominates: no worse on every material dimension and clearly better on at least one; any material within-dimension tradeoff prevents dominance

ensemble.YES: both carried forward, mean rank correlation between 0.20 and 0.80, Top-10 overlap <0.60, and documented failure/regime differences
ensemble.MAYBE: both carried but differentiation evidence incomplete
ensemble.NO: fewer than two carried or rankings effectively identical

freeze_readiness.READY: all freeze fields present and no material caveat
freeze_readiness.READY_WITH_CAVEATS: all freeze fields present with documented research/data caveats
freeze_readiness.NOT_READY: missing reproducibility field or hard rejection
